properties.name: Savage River water route
properties.evidence: Haygarth 2012 pp.61,63 & n.9: 'Until 1881 the Savage River was the thoroughfare between the Middletons Creek diggings and the Pieman River'; Donaldson Inn at the mouth 'could only be approached by water'.
properties.accuracy: route follows the river; spine sampled from LIST water-body polygons

properties.name: Pieman River water route
properties.evidence: Haygarth 2012 throughout: steamer and boat thoroughfare from the heads past Corinna to the middle reaches (Alma Cove, Echo Vale); Hangmans Creek '15 km upstream from the Pieman stores'.
properties.accuracy: route follows the river; spine sampled from LIST water-body polygons

properties.name: Corinna Track (Waratah road)
properties.evidence: Haygarth 2012 pp.62,67: subscription track Waratah to the Middletons Creek diggings incl. the 'Underground Railway'; 'The Corinna Track was improved to enable machinery to be hauled in from Waratah in 1883'; stores at Long Plains and the 20-Mile Mark; telegraph line 1882.
properties.accuracy: INDICATIVE — documented endpoints and waypoints (Waratah, Long Plains, Middletons Creek diggings, Corinna); exact alignment unknown

properties.name: Government Store track (1881)
properties.evidence: Haygarth 2012 p.65 & n.9: Government Store at Corinna 'and the completion of a track to it in 1881 diverted traffic away from Savage's inn'; the map 'shows the position of the Government Store, and the workings north of there at Middletons Creek'.
properties.accuracy: INDICATIVE — short documented connection Corinna store to the Middletons Creek workings; alignment unknown

properties.name: Sprent's track (1876)
properties.evidence: Haygarth 2012 p.57: Sprent's 'prospecting track from Waratah to Mount Heemskirk via the Ramsay River, Yellowband Plain and the middle reaches of the Pieman was not a supply route, being too rough for packhorses'.
properties.accuracy: INDICATIVE — documented waypoints (Waratah, Ramsay River, Yellowband Plain, middle Pieman, Mt Heemskirk); exact alignment unknown
